msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia bolsos-cati-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a soft dark aubergine leather shoulder bag with a zip from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia bolsos-cati-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a grey corduroy tote bag with two round handles from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia bolsos-cati-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a beige fluffy faux-fur half-moon handbag with a short handle from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia bolsos-cati-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a burgundy nylon shopper bag with two handles and a front zip pocket from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia bolsos-cati-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a burgundy patent leather shoulder bag with gold eyelets and a chain strap from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
